Name: Swiss Roll Recipes
Author: itsannette
Description:
[center]⋆ ˚｡⋆୨୧˚ The rolls have rolled into the valley. Let's have sweet roll cakes and be happy. ˚୨୧⋆｡˚ ⋆

Adds six new recipes that can be found directly in your kitchen. Customized gift tastes based on vanilla tastes. The villagers love them and you will too! Gain various buffs by eating them, some might help you eliminate the dragons. 

♥︎ New Recipes ♥︎
※ Cheese Cream Swiss Roll
※ Choco Vanilla Swiss Roll
※ Coffee Cream Swiss Roll
※ Creamy Blueberry Swiss Roll
※ Japanese Matcha Swiss Roll
※ Strawberry Peach Swiss Roll

♥︎ Requirements ♥︎
※ PPJA More Trees, PPJA More Recipes | needed to cook Choco Vanilla Swiss Roll
※ Json Assets[/center]
